notes: Research-only Ki Blast Ultimate candidates. Ultimate-Finish and CaC fields remain null unless the cited evidence explicitly resolves them.

records.name: Blaster Stream
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 148 — Finding Out About Fusion
records.mechanics_notes: Chargeable beam; charge increases damage and hit count; follow-up stronger Ki Wave on hit.

records.name: Full Power Destruction
records.character_source: Jiren (Full Power) Ultra Supervillain; Jiren — Customize Partner
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 177 — Warped Sense of Justice
records.mechanics_notes: Fires tracking Ki Blasts, then a follow-up blast and cinematic explosion if the opening sequence connects.

records.name: Gigantic Burst
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 127 — Multiverse Match of the Century
records.mechanics_notes: Two-stage attack: three sweeping Ki Waves followed by a spiraling energy wave; can be entered from Ray Blast when sufficiently fueled.

records.name: Lightning Impact
records.mechanics_notes: Channels Ki into a Ki Wave; rapid input increases charge and damage; opponent is paralyzed if they touch the user while charging.

records.name: Requiem of Destruction
records.mechanics_notes: Traps the opponent in a powerful Ki Blast and detonates it in a large explosion.
